articles.summary: The “Give Yourself the Freedom to” campaign invites people with diabetes around the world to show themselves compassion and self-care. Global survey data shows approximately 6 in 10 people with type 1 and type 2 diabetes want more holistic support, including mental health resources. Insulet is also supporting various diabetes community and colleague engagement initiatives around the globe. In recognition of World Diabetes Day on November 14, 2026, Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD) (Insulet or the Company), the global leader in tubeless insulin pump technology with its Omnipod ® brand of products, today announced its “Give Yourself the Freedom to” campaign designed to raise awareness of the often overlooked emotional and mental demands of living with diabetes and encourage people living with diabetes to prioritize their own well-being. “Living with diabetes extends far beyond managing glucose levels and making treatment decisions. articles.title: For World Diabetes Day, Insulet Launches “Give Yourself the Freedom to” Campaign, Encouraging People with Diabetes to Prioritize Their Well-Being

articles.summary: Brings Over Three Decades of Finance Experience Reaffirms Full Year 2026 Guidance Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD) (Insulet or the Company), the global leader in tubeless insulin pump technology with its Omnipod® brand, today announced that Todd Trapp has been appointed Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, effective December 7, 2026. He will succeed Flavia Pease, who will continue to serve in an advisory capacity over the following months to ensure a smooth transition. Mr. Trapp brings over 30 years of finance and accounting experience, with diverse expertise across global MedTech and Industrials companies. Most recently, he served as Chief Financial Officer of Resonetics, a leading medical contract design and manufacturing organization. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. articles.summary: New comic in collaboration with Marvel Comics, celebrates authentic diabetes representation and empowers people living with diabetes to see themselves as heroes of their own stories. ACTON, Mass. — (November 10, 2026) — Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD) (Insulet or the Company), the global leader in tubeless insulin pump technology with its Omnipod ® brand of products, today announced the launch of a new comic, Gluconaut: Strength of Stars, developed in collaboration with Marvel Comics. The latest comic features Podrick, a high school student who is navigating life with type 1 diabetes and worries about fitting in. When he embraces Omnipod, he gains confidence in managing his diabetes and transforms into the hero, Gluconaut. This new comic continues Insulet’s mission to inspire people with diabetes and empower them to adopt diabetes technology for the potential of improved results and quality of life.
